name: grok.com Slack connector
connect: Create the Slack app from integrations/grok_slack/app_manifest.yaml (id A0BTJMFPTT6) and install it in the workspace.

On the desktop, open http://127.0.0.1:8789/ (run-handoff.ps1 / handoff.py serve). Paste SLACK_BOT_TOKEN and SLACK_APP_TOKEN once. The loopback page encrypts them for the current user and never renders them back. Do not put Grok tokens into the Gemini 127.0.0.1:8780 handoff.
On a VM/container, put SLACK_BOT_TOKEN and SLACK_APP_TOKEN in the process environment or gitignored env file. Doctor and health report present/missing, never values.

Run python integrations/grok_slack/bridge.py doctor --json, python integrations/grok_slack/bridge.py health --json, python integrations/grok_slack/canary.py, then python integrations/grok_slack/bridge.py serve (or run.sh / systemd / Docker) on a host-neutral always-on VM or container. GitHub Actions is not an always-on Socket Mode host. Bryce's desktop is not required.
Every Slack event is ACKed, claimed, and sent to public Commons MCP route_grokcom_revenue_work at INTAKE.
Post the returned slack_reply only when connector.post_reply is true.
Persist the returned job identity, then call fire_action exactly once with grokcom.executor_job.arguments.
Observe wake_jobs/<job_id>.json through a SHA-pinned current-main GitHub readback.
Feed the capture through GROKCOM_RESULT. This connector is the only final Slack delivery owner; reuse the commons-grok-cloud slack_receipt envelope when present.
Do not publish DMs into the public Git-backed Grok queue. Current main has no measured private Grok execution road.
credentials: No Slack, GitHub, xAI, or grok.com credential is accepted by the Commons tool or stored in this repository.
